title: Add every smaller mask once
hook: A subset table can accumulate along one binary dimension at a time.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary masks, basic complex arithmetic for FFT, polynomial coefficients.
doesNotKnow: Compute subset sums over all submasks using one dimension at a time.

misconception: Updating masks in arbitrary dimension order can repeatedly count the same submask.
objective: Compute subset sums over all submasks using one dimension at a time.

claims.text: For each bit dimension, a mask containing that bit adds the value from the mask with it cleared. Completing each dimension once introduces every submask exactly once; arbitrary repeated additions would double-count contributions.
